0x1626ba7e.notice: Returns `0x1626ba7e` when `signature` is a valid signature over `hash` for this contract.
0x1626ba7e.dev: The magic value is `bytes4(keccak256("isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes)"))`. Any other return (or a revert) means invalid.

params.hash: The hash of the signed data.
params.signature: The signature bytes (opaque; format is account-defined).

natspec.notice: ERC-1271 contract-signature facet. Lets the Diamond declare a signature valid (for permits, Seaport orders, Permit2) when it is a valid signature from the configured `AccountSigner` owner.
natspec.dev: Stateless delegator — logic lives in {ERC1271SignatureLib}. Implements ERC-7739 defensive rehashing: accepts only nested `TypedDataSign` / `PersonalSign` envelopes bound to this account's EIP-712 domain (a plain signature over the raw hash is rejected), defeating cross-account replay.
